items.name: ABI_VERSION
items.signature: # [doc = " ABI version constant for the MAOS Spirit ABI."] # [doc = " Bumped according to the ABI Stability Triple rules (§8.5)."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " **Story 1a.1 freezes this at `0`**; Story 1b.4 bumps to `1`"] # [doc = " at the ComplianceClaim envelope freeze. Do NOT bump in this story"] # [doc = " — bumping here breaks the ABI baseline diff in unintended ways."] pub const ABI_VERSION : u32 = 0 ;

items.name: EvidenceKind
items.signature: # [doc = " Evidence supporting a compliance claim."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , PartialEq)] pub enum EvidenceKind { # [doc = " Replay of a calibration corpus whose SHA-256 is attested."] CorpusReplay { # [doc = " SHA-256 of the calibration corpus JSONL file."] corpus_sha256 : [u8 ; 32] , } , # [doc = " Reference to an external penetration test report."] PenTestReportRef { # [doc = " URL where the report can be retrieved."] url : String , } , # [doc = " Manual review performed by a named reviewer."] ManualReview { # [doc = " Identifier of the human reviewer who performed the review."] reviewer_id : String , } , # [doc = " Cross-Spirit agreement evidence from a multi-Spirit evaluation."] CrossSpiritAgreement { # [doc = " Spirit IDs of the participating Spirits."] participants : Vec < String > , # [doc = " Agreement rate among participants."] agreement_rate : f64 , } , }

items.name: PrincipleRef
items.signature: # [doc = " Principles the claim attests compliance with."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Additive enum with explicit discriminants. Adding a variant at the"] # [doc = " end is NOT an ABI break; removing or reordering IS."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , Copy , PartialEq , Eq)] # [repr (u8)] pub enum PrincipleRef { # [doc = " HIPAA §164.308 compliance."] Hipaa164308 = 0 , # [doc = " SOC 2 Type II compliance."] Soc2TypeIi = 1 , # [doc = " ISO 27001 compliance."] Iso27001 = 2 , # [doc = " EU AI Act Article 14 compliance."] EuAiActArt14 = 3 , # [doc = " Unknown or future principle — fallback."] UnknownPrinciple = 255 , }

items.name: SandboxTier
items.signature: # [doc = " Sandbox tier — OS-native sandbox primitive classification."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , Copy , PartialEq , Eq , PartialOrd , Ord)] # [repr (u8)] pub enum SandboxTier { # [doc = " Trusted — no additional sandbox."] T0 = 0 , # [doc = " UID separation."] T1 = 1 , # [doc = " Landlock+seccomp narrow / Seatbelt / Windows restricted-token."] T2 = 2 , # [doc = " T2 + container."] T3 = 3 , # [doc = " WASM-component sandbox (speculative-vNext)."] T4 = 4 , }

items.name: SigningAlg
items.signature: # [doc = " Signing algorithm identifier."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Additive enum: adding a variant at the end with explicit `#[repr(u8)]`"] # [doc = " discriminant is NOT an ABI break. Removing or reordering variants IS"] # [doc = " an ABI break per §8.5."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , Copy , PartialEq , Eq)] # [repr (u8)] pub enum SigningAlg { # [doc = " Ed25519 signature algorithm."] Ed25519 = 0 , }

items.name: TrustTier
items.signature: # [doc = " Trust tier — operator-visible metadata classification."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , Copy , PartialEq , Eq , PartialOrd , Ord)] # [repr (u8)] pub enum TrustTier { # [doc = " Operator-authored or personally vetted."] Local = 0 , # [doc = " Organization-internal, vouched by operator signing key."] OrgInternal = 1 , # [doc = " Public, vetted by community or operator."] PublicVetted = 2 , # [doc = " Public, no organizational vouch."] PublicUntrusted = 3 , }

items.name: Verdict
items.signature: # [doc = " Verdict rendered by the attesting party."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Explicit discriminants on every variant — reordering without updating"] # [doc = " discriminants is an ABI break per §8.5 self-test row #5."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , PartialEq , Eq)] # [repr (u8)] pub enum Verdict { # [doc = " Claim is valid; Spirit may be admitted under attested context."] Admit = 0 , # [doc = " Admitted but with operator-visible caveats."] AdmitWithCaveats { # [doc = " Human-readable caveat strings."] caveats : Vec < String > , } = 1 , # [doc = " Rejected: runtime context has drifted from attested context."] RejectContextDrift = 2 , # [doc = " Rejected: claim is structurally malformed."] RejectMalformedClaim = 3 , # [doc = " Rejected: claim has expired."] RejectExpiredClaim = 4 , # [doc = " Unknown or future verdict — fallback."] UnknownVerdict = 255 , }

items.name: CapabilityId
items.signature: # [doc = " Capability identifier — sorted, canonical, hash-stable."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , PartialEq , Eq , PartialOrd , Ord)] pub struct CapabilityId (pub String) ;

items.name: Claim
items.signature: # [doc = " The inner claim payload — what `claim_bytes` CBOR-encodes."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , PartialEq)] pub struct Claim { # [doc = " UUID v4 unique claim identifier."] # [doc = " At v0.1-α this is a zero-cost newtype around `[u8; 16]`;"] # [doc = " Story 1b.4 swaps in the real `uuid::Uuid` when serde derives ship."] pub claim_id : Uuid , # [doc = " Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the claim was issued."] pub issued_at_unix_ms : u64 , # [doc = " Optional expiry timestamp. None = no automatic expiry."] pub expires_at_unix_ms : Option < u64 > , # [doc = " Principles the claim attests compliance with."] pub principle_refs : Vec < PrincipleRef > , # [doc = " Evidence supporting the claim."] pub evidence : Vec < EvidenceKind > , # [doc = " Verdict rendered by the attesting party."] pub verdict : Verdict , }

items.name: ComplianceClaimEnvelope
items.signature: # [doc = " Ed25519-signed compliance claim envelope."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Canonical encoding for signature verification:"] # [doc = " `sign_bytes = sha256(claim_bytes)`. The signature signs the claim"] # [doc = " payload INDIRECTLY via its SHA-256 hash, keeping the envelope"] # [doc = " fixed-size and the signature verifiable without CBOR-parsing the"] # [doc = " claim at the verify step."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , PartialEq , Eq)] pub struct ComplianceClaimEnvelope { # [doc = " Ed25519 signature over `sha256(claim_bytes)`. 64 bytes."] pub signature : [u8 ; 64] , # [doc = " Ed25519 public key of the attesting party. 32 bytes."] pub attester_pubkey : [u8 ; 32] , # [doc = " Canonical CBOR-encoded `Claim` the signature covers (RFC 8949 canonical)."] pub claim_bytes : Vec < u8 > , # [doc = " Signing algorithm identifier."] pub signing_alg : SigningAlg , }

items.name: CryptoProviderId
items.signature: # [doc = " Crypto provider identifier per §8.6 pluggable crypto trait."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , PartialEq , Eq , PartialOrd , Ord)] pub struct CryptoProviderId (pub String) ;

items.name: ExecutionContextFingerprint
items.signature: # [doc = " Execution-context fingerprint bound to every ComplianceClaim."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The canonical encoding for hash purposes is:"] # [doc = " `fingerprint_hash = sha256(cbor_canonical(ser(&self)))`"] # [doc = " using RFC 8949 canonical CBOR."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , PartialEq , Eq)] pub struct ExecutionContextFingerprint { # [doc = " SHA-256 of the Spirit's manifest.toml after canonicalization."] pub manifest_hash : [u8 ; 32] , # [doc = " Semantic version of the Spirit whose manifest was hashed."] pub spirit_version : String , # [doc = " Trust tier per ADR-009."] pub trust_tier : TrustTier , # [doc = " Sandbox tier per ADR-004."] pub sandbox_tier : SandboxTier , # [doc = " Capability IDs the Spirit is authorized to hold."] # [doc = " Sorted (BTreeSet) for canonical hash stability."] pub capability_scope : BTreeSet < CapabilityId > , # [doc = " Provider + endpoint + optional model-version pin per ADR-005."] pub provider_endpoint : ProviderEndpointPin , # [doc = " Pluggable crypto provider identity per §8.6."] pub crypto_provider : CryptoProviderId , }

items.name: ProviderEndpointPin
items.signature: # [doc = " Provider endpoint pin per ADR-005 pluggable provider drivers."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , PartialEq , Eq)] pub struct ProviderEndpointPin { # [doc = " Provider identifier (e.g., \"anthropic\", \"openai\", \"ollama\")."] pub provider_id : String , # [doc = " Base URL of the provider's inference endpoint."] pub endpoint_url : String , # [doc = " Optional model identifier pin (model-version pinning ships at v1.0 per NFR-Sec-15)."] pub model_id : Option < String > , }

items.name: Uuid
items.signature: # [doc = " Zero-cost newtype wrapper around `[u8; 16]` at v0.1-α."] # [doc = " Replaced with `uuid::Uuid` in Story 1b.4."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The inner array is `pub(crate)` — private constructor is a deliberate"] # [doc = " ABI stability guarantee. External crates cannot construct a `Uuid`"] # [doc = " directly; only `maos-spirit-abi` internals and tests may do so."] # [doc = " Story 1b.4 swaps this for `uuid::Uuid` when serde derives ship."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , Copy , PartialEq , Eq , PartialOrd , Ord)] pub struct Uuid (pub (crate) [u8 ; 16]) ;
